title: Episode
description: Catalog row episode 1.0.0: one executed episode as reflexmesh `run_episode` returns it (evaluation/runner.py:164-205) and `evaluate` writes it (runner.py:376). One shape for the derived set (data/derived/episodes, lane owned-real-software) and the semantic-transfer set (data/derived/semantic-transfer/episodes, lane owned-semantic-transfer); the keys of events[].state and decisions[].effect_observed depend on the environment, so they are optional and closed (a key outside the union of the two sets is a contract change).

decisions.description: What the policy chose at each step: the candidates it scored, the action, the reason, the effect it predicted and the effect that was observed.

events.description: The state the environment showed at each step.

lane.description: owned-real-software for the derived set, owned-semantic-transfer for the semantic-transfer set (runner.py:171-176).

metrics.description: Counters and timings of the run; task_success is 1 when the independent effect predicates held.

parameters.description: Reserved by the engine; empty in every committed episode.

planner_work.description: Background planner activity: proposals, discards and provider usage.

policy_errors.description: Errors the policy raised; empty when the run was clean.

generated_at.description: When the engine wrote the episode (ISO 8601, UTC).

lineage_document.description: Path of the lineage document relative to the episode file.

lineage_signature.description: SHA-256 of the lineage document (sorted keys); equals the index provenance signature.

provenance.description: Split, ground-truth source, planner model, generation time and the lineage binding.

resources.description: The workspace resources the native broker reports at the end of the run.
